description.value: Nuba is a Vancouver Lebanese restaurant institution founded in 2003, rooted in founder Victor Bouzide's grandmother's recipes and built around fresh, local, and organic ingredients sourced daily. The Mount Pleasant location — branded 'Off Main' — offers the full mezze menu including falafel, hummus, and soups, with a large portion of items vegan and gluten-free. Walk-ins are welcome, making it an easy stop for a touring cyclist cutting through the East Side.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: stands (8 spaces) at 60m; rack at 61m; rack (4 spaces) at 70m; rack (3 spaces) at 71m; stands (6 spaces) at 80m; rack (6 spaces) at 96m; stands (2 spaces) at 98m. Total: 29 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms the OSM record matches the 'Off Main Mount Pleasant' Nuba location at 146 E Third Ave, phone 604-568-6727. The menu pages document extensive vegan and GF items, and the site has an 'Order Online' function confirming takeout. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or charging anywhere in the website content.
concerns: Website brands this location as 'Off Main Mount Pleasant' rather than just 'Nuba' — OSM name 'Nuba' is technically the parent brand, not the location-specific name. Minor discrepancy, not a material issue.

Nuba has four Vancouver locations (Gastown, Yaletown, Kitsilano, Mount Pleasant); other OSM records for the same brand may exist — check for duplicates at 207 West Hastings St, 508 Davie St, and 3116 W Broadway.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active Lebanese restaurant with confirmed address, phone, and online presence. Strong vegan and GF menu makes it particularly appealing to diverse touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: All meats listed on menu are halal, non-medicated, and hormone-free per the About page — relevant to cyclists with dietary requirements.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states 'A large portion of our menu items are vegan.' Menu pages tag numerous dishes explicitly as Vegan and/or GF (e.g. Garden Falafel, Mjadra, all hummus varieties, Najib's Special)

wow_evidence: Vancouver Lebanese restaurant institution founded in 2003
